regime_context: Detector shows a dominant one-narrative tape in China A-shares: Banks (512800.SS) is the only eligible, crowded, broad leader (0.907 score, 0.75 durability-bar, 0.833 breadth), while everything else sits below the absolute-trend gate. Crucially, gate_helps is false and backtest_verdict says the trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so even the one validated edge (drawdown control) is not reliable here — this is an experimental/display situation. Track record direction accuracy is 0.373 (below coin-flip) over 126 calls, so I am leaning low and framing everything as conditionals, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners hold rank 2 and a 0.68 score with hurst 'trend' but are gate-ineligible (durability_bar 0.38, breadth 0.167) and unscorable (no ETF proxy). I am watching for Gold Miners to cross the trend gate (become eligible) with breadth rising above 0.4 AND a scorable proxy appearing — that combination would retire this watch and constitute a CONFIRMED leadership handoff away from Banks, not before.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the single eligible theme under the trend gate, with the strongest durability-bar (0.75), highest breadth (0.833), and a trending hurst tag. This is not an alpha claim — it is a structure read: leadership is concentrated, broad, and trend-healthy, so the prevailing narrative is coherent rather than fragile. I lean with the leader only as a conditional on its own trend health persisting, not because it ranks first.
evidence: eligible == true (only theme eligible alongside Innovative Pharma, but Pharma is rank 9 and much weaker)
crowded == true (sizing caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z=1.82) and one-narrative dominant; on this market's mean-reverting tape, crowded leaders have historically whipped back. gate_helps=false means the trend gate that would normally protect a Bank overweight did not reduce drawdown here, so the usual de-risking mechanism is untrustworthy.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% over the next 21 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is technically eligible (trend gate passed) but it is rank 9 of 22, breadth is weak at 0.429, hurst is 'mixed', and it is crowded (z=1.35). Passing the gate while lacking durability and breadth is a weaker structure than Banks — a trend-follower would prefer the broad leader over a narrow, mixed, crowded also-eligible. Avoid expresses 'not the place for directional exposure', not a short.
theses.dissent: It is one of only two eligible themes, and its crowding plus gate passage could mean real institutional flow is accumulating before a breadth expansion. On a mean-reverting tape, a contrarian might see crowded-but-eligible as an entry, not an avoid.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms the CSI 300 by 3% over the next 21 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
